description: Conformance vectors for https://a2a-rust.com/extensions/budget/v1. Each 'valid' status is read as 'reads'; each 'invalid' one is refused. Numbers are read from any whole JSON number, a float such as 30000.0 included (a protobuf Struct writes every number as a double), up to 2^53; a fraction, a negative or a value past the field's range is refused. Run by crates/a2a-protocol-types/tests/extension_vectors.rs, each value read through the SDK's own reader, and checked against the schema beside it.

valid.name: as a protobuf Struct writes it
